info.title: TravelVN (VN.TRAVEL) API
info.description: OpenAPI 3.0 specification for TravelVN — a full-stack Next.js 15 mini-OTA platform with Dual-Portal Auth (Client & Admin RBAC), Multi-Departure Inventory with 15-min atomic seat holds, HMAC-SHA256 Payment Webhooks, Loyalty Ledger, and Gemini AI Concierge.

clientCookieAuth.name: client_token
clientCookieAuth.description: HttpOnly HS256 JWT cookie (`type: CLIENT_USER`) for authenticated customers.

clientResetCookieAuth.name: client_reset_token
clientResetCookieAuth.description: HttpOnly HS256 JWT cookie (`purpose: client_password_reset`, 10m TTL) issued after OTP verification.

oauthStateCookieAuth.name: oauth_state
oauthStateCookieAuth.description: HttpOnly CSRF state cookie (10m TTL) for Google OAuth 2.0 callback.

adminCookieAuth.name: admin_token
adminCookieAuth.description: HttpOnly HS256 JWT cookie (`type: ADMIN_USER`) for authenticated admin accounts.

adminResetCookieAuth.name: admin_reset_token
adminResetCookieAuth.description: HttpOnly HS256 JWT cookie (`purpose: password_reset`, 10m TTL) issued after admin OTP verification.

webhookHmacSignature.name: X-Webhook-Signature
webhookHmacSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest (optional `sha256=` prefix) of raw request body using `PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (fallback `JWT_SECRET`).
